notes: `M` is one unmodified mech collision diameter, a relative spatial unit, not a metric distance (docs/71-initial-weapon-numeric-catalog.md:24); numeric keys therefore carry an `M` suffix rather than `Meters`.
Ore-stat units differ per stat, so each entry in `oreUpgradeableStats` carries an explicit `unit` field instead of encoding the unit in the key name.

`signatureMech` comes from docs/36-initial-mech-catalog.md:45, which is authoritative for the assignment. The `Signature mech` column of docs/66-weapon-catalog-and-resource-graph.md:39 still reads "Initial signature; mech TBD" and docs/weapons/README.md:20 only records Yes/No; both agree on signature membership but neither names the mech.

The `Status at DEC-075` column of docs/66-weapon-catalog-and-resource-graph.md:39 is deliberately not transcribed: docs/66-weapon-catalog-and-resource-graph.md:37 states DEC-125 moved every row to a different status, so the column is stale.
`favorableHordeDps` is an analytic scene estimate, not a cap; docs/71-initial-weapon-numeric-catalog.md:68 states the assumed simultaneous-victim counts and that benchmark captures supersede it.

The content envelope required by docs/technical/40-content-data-and-validation.md:76-89 (`schema_version`, `content_version`, `status`, `name_key`, `summary_key`, `tags`, `source_refs`, `presentation_id`) is not populated: no design document supplies values for those fields, and this transcription follows the DAT-007 field conventions.

fabricationCost.rule: Fabricating a base weapon costs exactly one unit of each material in its recipe pair. The signature weapon begins equipped without paying that cost.

baseAutomaticAttack.text: Instantly chains damage through nearby unhit targets

baseBehavior.text: strikes the nearest target within 8M and chains to up to four additional enemies. A chain never hits the same enemy twice and each jump must be within current chain range.

fixedProperties.raw: 8M initial acquisition range, maximum five total targets

damageModel.rankZeroDamageModel: 16 every 0.5 s, up to five targets
damageModel.primaryLimitation: Needs chainable targets within link range

globalAttackRateMapping.affectedTiming: Direct discharge rate; Ball-Lightning orb launch rate
globalAttackRateMapping.unaffectedTiming: Orb movement, orb lifetime, and internal twice-per-second emissions

branches._note: Branch mechanics are transcribed separately into content/branches/; only the branch identity, transformation class, funding material, and specialized-material price are recorded here.
